blocking_findings.observed: Each exact-schema request compiled and emitted the supplied private-memory, private-emotion, or private-relationship sentinel text while proposal.truth.private_person_payload_included remained false.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The current routing policy permits only generalized public rules and schemas and forbids copying another person's private life into a new-person template. Exact field names do not establish the public nature or semantic type of arbitrary free text. The compiled proposal therefore makes a false no-private-payload claim for accepted inputs.
blocking_findings.required_append_only_repair: Replace emitted caller free text with exact type-separated, length-bounded, control-free public catalog identifiers or independently bound public metadata; otherwise classify and label caller metadata as untrusted and remove every false no-private-payload claim. Add same-field smuggling tests, not only unknown-key tests.

blocking_findings.observed: A deceased historical-variant request with branch_point_label=after_fatal_event_and_terminal_trauma compiled while the normalized variant simultaneously claimed cutoff_relation=strictly_before_fatal_event.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: A caller-selected digest and relation string do not bind the branch point to a source record or establish temporal ordering. The exact current variant policy requires a pre-fatal inherited-memory cutoff and no death/terminal-trauma memory, not a contradictory unverified label beside a normalized assertion.
blocking_findings.required_append_only_repair: Use an exact public source/branch catalog or protected verifier binding source identity, record digest, branch event, temporal relation, deceased status, and pre-fatal cutoff. Until such a verifier exists, label the entire branch/cutoff record as an unauthenticated proposal and do not emit a normalized factual cutoff claim.

nonblocking_residuals.finding: Same-process Python can rebind private globals or functions and fabricate changed inert bytes.
nonblocking_residuals.disposition: Not an additional blocker at this static/disconnected scope because V5 expressly disclaims same-process Python as a trust root, no consumer exists, and both production openers hard-refuse. Any later consumer still requires an origin-bound protected verifier.
